responsibility: Implements conditional status printing controlled by `M2Options.Quiet`. Each exported `qprintf*` routine simply forwards to the corresponding `M2Printf.printf*` helper when quiet mode is off, making this file the small policy layer that suppresses nonessential front-end console output without changing callers.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file contains the actual quiet-mode behavior—conditionally calling `M2Printf.printf*` only when `Quiet` is false—while the same-name `.def` file merely defines the wrapper signatures.
